notes: Reconstructed from R2D2_Coordinates_and_Segment_Numbering.pdf (Bosch CR/AES3.1, KiCad V1.0, 12.12.2025) and the copper layer plot. 15 full-height vertical strips of 1,3,2,3,1,5,5,5,5,5,1,3,2,3,1 pad columns. The 9 wide strips carry 4 segments each (5 pad rows), the 6 narrow strips carry 6 (2,5,3,3,5,2). 9*4 + 6*6 = 72 segments over 900 pads. The row split inside the narrow edge strips is the one place a different reading is conceivable; verify against the KiCad board file, then this file is exact.
